notes:
Typing fix: a new paragraph no longer starts with a space while macOS keeps Secure Input on. talk2me now counts the keys you press then, such as Return, and still adds the space between 2 dictations in a row.
Shortcut fixes: the key listener no longer leaves old copies running when it restarts. A recording is typed when the shortcut stops during it, and a stopped shortcut tries again by itself after 2, 5, 15 and 60 seconds.
Home: "Voice model" shows your languages as pills, Settings is a link under the cards, "100% private" replaces "Made in Canada", and Recent results show only once there is one. Settings has a Home tab, and Voice and Cleanup are shorter. On a new Mac whose GPU cleans text, cleanup is on by default.
